liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Box of Rain** (1 review): The performance is described as warm and rich, transcending any interpretation [14]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Described as the best version heard, characterized as smooth and rich like coffee [11]
- **Playin' in the Band** (1 review): After the second chorus, Jerry steps on the wah-wah, leading to a twenty-minute jam [9]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Garcia sounds like he is playing pedal steel, fumbling with slide and open strings [16]

## The recordings

- **gd73-03-16.sbd.hamilton-jackson.167.14770.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 204 min; rated 4.57/5 by 30 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry's guitar-fiddle tone is highlighted as amazing, with the rest of the band following; Sound mix improves after about a song and a half, resulting in a very good recording [7][8]
- **gd1973-03-16.sbd.cantor.hamilton.167.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 204 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Known flaws include static, hum, dropouts, and reel splices due to '73 sound system or waterlogged reels [2]
- **gd73-03-16.sbd.cribbs.19141.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 207 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [3]. Said about its sound: The first disc is finely crisp, while the second is called a religious experience [11]
- **gd1973-03-16.sbd.miller.79186.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 195 min; rated 4.37/5 by 19 [4]. Said about its sound: This version lacks flaws of other sources, offers upgraded sound quality, but has static in Sugar Magnolia [4]
- **gd1973-03-16.152003.SonyStereo.ECM.Moskal.t.flac16**: source not stated; 26 songs; 191 min [6]. Said about its sound: Quality is better than the previous night, with an improved mix, though the encore degrades [6]

## Around the show

- Billy is described as being in a deep listening state, responding to everyone [8]
- Audience members threw joints on stage; Jerry told them to stop throwing and just smoke [12]
- Bill Graham introduces the band as being from San Francisco, despite the New York location [17]
- Bill Graham introduces the band as being from California, their home state [18]
- Sons Of Champlin did not play due to lead singer's father's death; New Riders opened [6]
- This show and the Utica show on the 22nd are named as favorites of the run [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-03-16.sbd.hamilton-jackson.167.14770.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Set 1 lineage: Betty MSR to PCM, DAT, CDR, EAC, SHN; Set 2: MSR to Reel, DAT, CD, EAC, SHN [1]
- **gd1973-03-16.sbd.cantor.hamilton.167.shnf**: transferred by James Warner and G. S. Hamilton; source: Set 1: Betty MSR > PCM > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN and Set 2: MSR > Reel > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN [2]
- **gd73-03-16.sbd.cribbs.19141.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1973-03-16.sbd.miller.79186.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k) DSet 2: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) D [4]
- **gd1973-03-16.152003.SonyStereo.ECM.Moskal.t.flac16**: taped by Gerry Moskal; transferred by Gerry Moskal & Brian Mandel; source: Sony Stereo ECM -->SONY TCD126 Location: TBD [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum - March 16, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/march-16-1973) [20]
